source:
@@U01719@@
You send up sighs to the Father on high
for your agony and for His.
But who can know, who can feel,
the rage that tears me?
Who can know my fear
and the tremble of my heart?
Who but you, sweet Mother?
Wherever I go,
what woe, what woe, what woe,
I feel in my heart!
Alone,
I weep, I weep, and I weep,
till my heart is torn.
At dawn when I picked these flowers,
the pots at my window were wet with my tears.
The sun shines into my room so brightly,
and I sit on my bed engulfed in agony.
Lady! Mother! Help me!
Save me from disgrace and death!
Mother of sorrows, behold me in my distress.

@@U01721@@
The street in front of 格蕾琴’ door.
瓦伦丁, a soldier, 格蕾琴’ brother.

@@U01723@@
Time was I'd sit drinking with the boys,
listening to them boast about their girls,
and wash it down with another drink or two.
There I sat, smiling,
stroking my chin at all their big talk.
translation:
@@U01719@@
你向高天之父发出叹息
为了你的痛苦，也为了他的痛苦。
但谁能知道，谁能感受，
让我流泪的愤怒？
谁能知道我的恐惧
我的心在颤抖？
亲爱的妈妈，除了你还有谁？
无论我走到哪里，
什么祸事，什么祸事，什么祸事，
我心里感觉！
独自一人，
我哭了，我哭了，我哭了，
直到我的心被撕裂。
黎明时分，当我摘下这些花时，
窗边的花盆都被我的泪水打湿了。
阳光照进我的房间，那么明亮，
我坐在床上，痛苦万分。
女士！母亲！帮我！
救我脱离耻辱和死亡！
悲伤之母，请看我的痛苦。

@@U01721@@
格蕾琴门前的街道。
瓦伦丁，一名军人，格蕾琴的兄弟。

@@U01723@@
那时我会和男孩们一起喝酒，
听他们夸耀自己的女儿，
然后再喝一两杯饮料。
我坐在那里，微笑着，
他们的大话都抚摸着我的下巴。
